trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy in the game and this one unlocks by itself. Nothing here is online and nothing needs downloadable content, so it is purely a matter of finishing the other 54. Expect roughly 200 hours at a relaxed pace.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It is the first mission of the game and cannot be missed — just follow the story until the mission ends and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The trophy actually pops at the start of Chapter 2, after the first mission there, rather than on the last Chapter 1 cutscene, so keep playing one mission past the chapter end.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it pops at the start of the next chapter, after the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City — not the moment Chapter 2's story ends.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. It pops at the start of Chapter 4, after the first two missions there, Ocean Beach and Another Life, so keep playing a little past the chapter's end.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 by completing its final mission, Starting From Zero. The trophy pops when the chapter closes; the final mission itself has its own gold trophy, so expect two pops close together.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. The guides disagree about which chapter it belongs to, so no chapter is claimed here — simply play the story to its end and the trophy pops when the mission finishes.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. It is a story mission, so it cannot be missed — play the story normally and the trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. Story mission, unmissable: just play through the heist to its conclusion and the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play in Chapter 4. Another unmissable story mission — follow the mission to its end and the trophy pops when it finishes.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners in Chapter 4. Play the story mission through to the end; the trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. A story mission like the rest here: finish it and the trophy pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. The guides place it in Chapter 5, the final chapter, so expect it late in the story; finish the mission and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the checklist under Progress, then Stats — it only appears after the story. Partial milestones help along the way: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, and in full all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting-range golds, drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks. Progress made before the story ends still counts.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Track them under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts. Note that 100% completion needs 300, so keep going past this trophy if you want the full checklist.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try one of each of the nine activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range, pool, basketball (sink a basket), an arcade or video game, winning a race, and performing a stunt. Track them under Progress, then Activities. Each needs only one attempt, not a win, except where the activity itself demands it.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 ranges. The ranges also raise your Focus level, so the practice pays twice. Gold every challenge in a range before moving on, and check the range's own leaderboard for the gold threshold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — 42 races in total, since every location hosts several. Winning one race per location is enough for this trophy, but 100% completion needs all 42 wins, so treat the rest as later cleanup.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; 40 races exist in the game, and repeating one you already won does not count. Pick a spread of race types across the map so you are always racing somewhere new, and the trophy pops on the twentieth distinct win.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. You meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui; afterwards he texts you a purple-marked fishing spot. Follow his fishing questline, take the challenge when it is offered, and out-fish him to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game, all of its levels, in a single run. Four games count: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind on the home TV, plus Bang For Your Buck on arcade cabinets. Pick the shortest and play it through.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's last mission. She is Lucia-only and her strand starts in Chapter 3 — watch for her call or text, with the address in Belville. Her five quests run in order: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, then Puff Puff Pass. It stays available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's last mission. Kenton, marked by a green KR icon as Key Lento, hires you in Chapter 1 to recover treasure from seven shipwrecks: dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig the treasure up. He vanishes after Chapter 1 but texts Jason again later; the strand finishes after the story. Track it under Progress, Collections, Kenton's Treasures.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last mission. His five jobs come from the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break; the last is Hometown Heroes. It stays available after the story, so there is no rush.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight qualifying stranger mission strands across Leonida. Confirmed to count are Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count, and the remaining qualifying strands are still being confirmed by the guides — check the trophy's own in-game progress counter to see where you stand.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's last mission. His Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, which gives you the Key Cloner: deliver 16 sports cars to his garage in west Vice City, marked with a green RK icon. The Zorrusso delivered during that mission counts as one. Scan cars with WAiNK to check the list; hotel driveways at Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are good hunting grounds.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's last mission. He is Jason-only, and his strand opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City, then finish with the final job Shut Down the Labs. It stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: The Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house may be required, but the guides have not confirmed whether it counts toward the 18 — do it in Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, to be safe. Every other spot stays available after the story.
trophies.guide: Meditate at 18 spots across 10 locations; meditating with both characters at a spot counts as two. Track them under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. The last spot needs both characters, so it only opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Only 15 of 18 are needed for 100% completion. Possibly missable: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house may be required — do it in Chapter 1 to be safe.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. He is Jason-only and texts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break; the first quest is Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Hunt the animals on his Target Decks, marked in purple, and bring them back as Jason. Which animal triggers the trophy is still unconfirmed by the guides, but 100% completion needs all 15 Target Decks anyway. The first quest rewards the unique rifle Killtelligence SM-69.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any three Collectible Card sets — 18 sets exist in total. Track per-set progress under Progress, then Collections. Cards turn up across the map, so collect as you travel rather than hunting one set at a time.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan any 100 WAiNK spots with the phone app: hold Up, then R1. The pools are 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities and 23 Sculptures, plus No Flusher tags. Scan everything you pass while travelling and the hundred comes naturally.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges, tracked under Progress, then Challenges. 100% completion needs 70 of 80, so the last twenty are a cleanup job — but this trophy only asks for fifty, which most players reach through normal play.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, lose a 4-star Wanted Level and escape the red heat zone. Both characters must be together, which needs the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break first. Bank vault robberies always give four stars, so it often pops there. A cited escape route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops back-to-back while still wanted — flashing red and blue, not the heat zone. The pop is delayed about thirty seconds after leaving the third shop; rob a fourth if it does not pop. Three jewelry stores in north Vice City, after the Chapter 3 Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, make a handy cluster.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with WAiNK — you do not need to drive them. There are 557 vehicles at launch and 277 base models, of which 200 are needed for 100% completion. Scan every new car you see and the hundred arrives quickly.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down five enemies in a single use of Combat Focus: press L3 and R3 together while aiming to slow time. Fill Focus first with food and drink — Adrenaline extends it — and an assault rifle is recommended. Gang-operation thugs count; police, soldiers and civilians reportedly do not.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger jet docked at a VCIA boarding bridge — gates E3 and E4 are cited; planes parked on the airfield do not count. Enter the cockpit, back out to the runway, take off and fly about a kilometre from the airport; the pop is delayed. Save first, because the police respond fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station, on the southwest island in Mariana County — the tanks sit at the south end of the base. Drive and shoot until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Chapter 3 Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which gives you the Snap Gun for the locked back door — kicking it in trips the alarm. Find the safe-code note in the back room, open the safe and leave unseen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is cited.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape — eight exist, and 100% completion needs all eight. Vaults open through the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is: tail a security van to a bank and enter while the vault is open. Bring your partner, since the haul is too heavy alone. Each vault pays up to $205,000, and Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. A bank-vault robbery counts automatically, so this often pops while chasing the vault trophy. The earlier method is to box a truck in, sticky-bomb its back doors, then escape the red heat zone or visit a Pay 'n' Spray.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. The guides say only to fully unfog the whole map, fastest by plane over the dark patches — no opened source states an area count, so no count is claimed here. Rockstar officially names six regions: Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the nine gangs — the yellow map icons — and track per-gang counts under Progress, then Gangs. There are 39 operations in total and 100% completion needs all of them, but one per gang is enough here.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method has been published yet for this trophy. The official description points to enjoying a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, and that is all the guides confirm — the exact steps are still unconfirmed, so do not trust any walkthrough that claims them. Check back once players publish a verified method.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method has been published yet for this trophy. The official description points to smashing your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style, and that is all the guides confirm. The exact steps are still unconfirmed, so treat any claimed method as a guess until a guide verifies it.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Take all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a gang operation first marked by the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the office safe in the north-east hallway, blown with Sticky Bombs. It pops after escaping the police, not on pickup, and the items need not all be taken in one visit — the robbery respawns after a long time.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength for both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Train at fitness clubs with your partner along — training one trains the other — or at home after the story. Both characters are needed, which means after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. PlayStation shows the running total when you open the trophy. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications under Settings, then UI, to watch it climb. Profiles run Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho and finally Irredeemable, which is permanent — avoid pushing that far. It fills passively through robberies and fights.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method has been published yet for this trophy. The description hints at a second try being the charm. PowerPyx believes it relates to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, but that is unconfirmed belief, not a verified method — GTABase only glosses the description. Do not treat the Payday Loans idea as confirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method has been published yet for this trophy. The description asks what just happened, and the guides agree only that something strange is involved. PowerPyx believes it comes from a UFO questline, but that is unconfirmed belief, not a verified method — GTABase only expects a strange event or Easter egg. Wait for a verified report.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method has been published yet for this trophy. The description points to knocking people down with a melee drive-by. PowerPyx believes it means kicking enemies while riding a motorcycle, but that is unconfirmed belief — GTABase glosses it only as a melee attack from a vehicle. Do not treat either guess as confirmed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts, cumulatively. You need the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, Meet Raul's Crew, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell marked bills to fences — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, cumulatively. Guns, car mods and tattoos burn through it fastest. Just play normally and buy what you use, and the total climbs without grinding.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate phone app, after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, for about $160,000 in total. The four garages the story gives you do not count toward the eight.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Moses' Chapter 2 mission opens the app: take stolen vehicles to his Port Gellhorn garage, Respray them, then Register. From Chapter 3, Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked cars too. You need free garage space for each one.
